chapter: Learning drums and Roy Eldridge's band
title: Roy Eldridge hears him; 1932, Prohibition repeal and the union
summary: Roy Eldridge heard him and he joined Roy in 1932 as beer returned; a question about the union goes unanswered.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Oh, yes. And that did it for me. And then Roy Eldridge heard me.
Oh, yeah. I was with Roy Eldridge in 1932.
Well, listen, let's see, we didn't actually say what year this was when you were 17. You were born in 1914.
Because I remember the next year I went with Roy, that Roosevelt -- that Prohibition was repealed, and we were working in nightclubs at that time, and when beer came in then --
Well, listen, what about the union?
